verdict.rationale: Ollama's control surface is CLI commands (ollama run, ollama pull, ollama launch) and REST/OpenAI-compatible APIs, not natural-language instructions to operate the tool itself; the natural-language interaction happens inside the models it hosts, not as a way to drive Ollama's own operations. No evidence pack item shows a chat-driven or NL command layer for managing Ollama (installing, launching agents, switching models) — those are all done via explicit CLI syntax.
